legend: Buber is a Berland technology company that specializes in waste of investor's money. Recently Buber decided to transfer its infrastructure to a cloud. The company decided to rent CPU cores in the cloud for n%%ZSMJ0%% consecutive days, which are numbered from 1%%ZSMJ1%% to n%%ZSMJ2%%. Buber requires k%%ZSMJ3%% CPU cores each day.
The cloud provider offers m%%ZSMJ4%% tariff plans, the i%%ZSMJ5%%-th tariff plan is characterized by the following parameters:
li%%ZSMJ6%% and ri%%ZSMJ7%% — the i%%ZSMJ8%%-th tariff plan is available only on days from li%%ZSMJ9%% to ri%%ZSMJ10%%, inclusive,
ci%%ZSMJ11%% — the number of cores per day available for rent on the i%%ZSMJ12%%-th tariff plan,
pi%%ZSMJ13%% — the price of renting one core per day on the i%%ZSMJ14%%-th tariff plan.

Buber can arbitrarily share its computing core needs between the tariff plans. Every day Buber can rent an arbitrary number of cores (from 0 to ci%%ZSMJ15%%) on each of the available plans. The number of rented cores on a tariff plan can vary arbitrarily from day to day.

Find the minimum amount of money that Buber will pay for its work for n%%ZSMJ16%% days from 1%%ZSMJ17%% to n%%ZSMJ18%%. If on a day the total number of cores for all available tariff plans is strictly less than k%%ZSMJ19%%, then this day Buber will have to work on fewer cores (and it rents all the available cores), otherwise Buber rents exactly k%%ZSMJ20%% cores this day.
input: The first line of the input contains three integers n%%ZSMJ21%%, k%%ZSMJ22%% and m%%ZSMJ23%% (1≤n,k≤106,1≤m≤2⋅105%%ZSMJ24%%) — the number of days to analyze, the desired daily number of cores, the number of tariff plans.

The following m%%ZSMJ25%% lines contain descriptions of tariff plans, one description per line. Each line contains four integers li%%ZSMJ26%%, ri%%ZSMJ27%%, ci%%ZSMJ28%%, pi%%ZSMJ29%% (1≤li≤ri≤n%%ZSMJ30%%, 1≤ci,pi≤106%%ZSMJ31%%), where li%%ZSMJ32%% and ri%%ZSMJ33%% are starting and finishing days of the i%%ZSMJ34%%-th tariff plan, ci%%ZSMJ35%% — number of cores, pi%%ZSMJ36%% — price of a single core for daily rent on the i%%ZSMJ37%%-th tariff plan.
output: Print a single integer number — the minimal amount of money that Buber will pay.
